name: Дедлайны
sqlQuery:
DECLARE @StartDate DATETIME = '20260101';
WITH TaskHistoryRanked AS (
    SELECT 
        th.TaskId,
        th.Deadline,
        th.Changed,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY th.TaskId ORDER BY th.Changed DESC) AS RowNum
    FROM dbo.TaskHistory th
    WHERE th.BlocksChanged LIKE 'deadline%' OR th.BlocksChanged LIKE '%,deadline%' 
),
TaskWait AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        StatusId,
        OldStatusId,
        BlocksChanged,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId] ORDER BY [Changed] DESC) AS RowNum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId]) AS TaskIdRowCount
    FROM 
        [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[TaskHistory]
    WHERE 
        [Changed] >= @StartDate
        AND [BlocksChanged] LIKE '%statusid%' AND StatusId = 98
),
TaskEx AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        BlocksChanged,
        (
          SELECT TOP 1 u.Name
          FROM [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[User] u
          WHERE u.CompanyId = 169 
          AND ',' + REPLACE(Executors, ', ', ',') + ',' LIKE '%,' + u.Name + ',%'
        ) AS Expert,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId] ORDER BY [Changed] ASC) AS RowNum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId]) AS TaskIdRowCount
    FROM 
        [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[TaskHistory]
    WHERE 
        [Changed] >= @StartDate
        AND [BlocksChanged] LIKE '%taskexecutors%' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[User] u
          WHERE u.CompanyId = 169 
          AND ',' + REPLACE(Executors, ', ', ',') + ',' LIKE '%,' + u.Name + ',%'
      )
),
TaskSPV AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        StatusId,
        OldStatusId,
        BlocksChanged,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId] ORDER BY [Changed] ASC) AS RowNum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId]) AS TaskIdRowCount
    FROM 
        [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[TaskHistory]
    WHERE 
        [Changed] >= @StartDate
        AND [BlocksChanged] LIKE '%field6154%'
),
TaskSOGL AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        StatusId,
        OldStatusId,
        BlocksChanged,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId] ORDER BY [Changed] DESC) AS RowNum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId]) AS TaskIdRowCount
    FROM 
        [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[TaskHistory]
    WHERE 
        [Changed] >= @StartDate
        AND [BlocksChanged] LIKE '%statusid%' AND StatusId = 90
),
TaskTHS AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        BlocksChanged,
        Deadline,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TaskId ORDER BY Changed ASC) AS RowNum
    FROM 
        dbo.TaskHistory
    WHERE 
        BlocksChanged LIKE '%statusid%' AND OldStatusId = 31
),
TaskTHH AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        BlocksChanged,
        StatusId,
    LastStatusChangedDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TaskId ORDER BY Changed ASC) AS RowNum
    FROM 
        dbo.TaskHistory
    WHERE 
        BlocksChanged LIKE '%statusid%' AND StatusId = 165
),
Taskclose AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
        StatusId,
    LastStatusChangedDate,
        BlocksChanged,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId] ORDER BY [Changed] DESC) AS RowNum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId]) AS TaskIdRowCount
    FROM 
        [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[TaskHistory]
    WHERE 
    [BlocksChanged] LIKE '%statusid%' and StatusId = 28
)
SELECT * FROM(
  SELECT
  srv.NameXml.value('(//Language/Ru)[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Сервис',
  t.Id AS '№',
  st.NameXml.value('(//Language/Ru)[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Статус',
  CASE
  WHEN t.Categories like '%Аудит%' and (LEN(t.Data.value('(//field[@id=1317]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')) < 3 or t.Data.value('(//field[@id=1317]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') IS NULL) THEN 'Удалить'
  ELSE t.Categories
  END AS 'Категории', 
  t.Executors AS 'Исполнители',
  FORMAT(t.Created, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Создана',
  p.NameXml.value('(//Language/Ru)[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Приоритет',
  FORMAT(t.Deadline, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Срок (план)',
  FORMAT(t.ResolutionDateFact, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Срок (факт)',
  CASE 
    WHEN t.ResolutionOverdue = 1 THEN 'Да'
    ELSE 'Нет'
  END AS 'Время исполнения истекло',
  FORMAT(t.Data.value('(//field[@id=6155]/text())[1]', 'DATE'), 'dd.MM.yyyy') AS 'Срок ремонта',
  FORMAT(thh.LastStatusChangedDate, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата статуса СПВ',
  FORMAT(spv.Changed, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата поля СПВ',
  t.Data.value('(//field[@id=1317]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Внешний номер',
  FORMAT(sgl.Changed, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата статуса\n  Принято на согласование',
  CASE
  WHEN t.TypeId = 1039 THEN 'ЛантаСервис-универсальная'
  END AS 'Тип',
  FORMAT(thw.Changed, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата статуса\n  Ожидание информации от Клиента',
  FORMAT(tx.Changed, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата назначения Эксперта',
  FORMAT(t.Data.value('(//field[@id=5877]/text())[1]', 'DATETIME'), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата отправки 1-го запроса',
  FORMAT(t.Data.value('(//field[@id=5878]/text())[1]', 'DATETIME'), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата отправки 2-го запроса',
  t.Data.value('(//field[@id=5879]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Ф.И.О. ответственного за согласование со стороны Клиента',
  t.Data.value('(//field[@id=1344]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Согласование от Клиента',
  t.Data.value('(//field[@id=2493]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Предварительная выставленная сумма Клиенту',
  t.Data.value('(//field[@id=1343]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Согласованная стоимость ЗИПа Клиентом',
  FORMAT(tskcl.LastStatusChangedDate, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS 'Дата статуса Закрыто',
  reg.NameXml.value('(//Language/Ru)[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Регион',
  usr.Name AS 'Заявитель'
  FROM 
    dbo.Task t
  LEFT JOIN dbo.Service srv ON t.ServiceId = srv.Id
  LEFT JOIN dbo.Status st ON t.StatusId = st.Id
  LEFT JOIN dbo.TaskTypeComboBox ttcb ON t.Data.value('(//field[@id=6154]/text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(MAX)') = ttcb.Id
  LEFT JOIN dbo.Priority p ON t.PriorityId = p.Id
  LEFT JOIN TaskTHS ths ON t.Id = ths.TaskId AND ths.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN TaskTHH thh ON t.Id = thh.TaskId AND thh.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN TaskWait thw ON t.Id = thw.TaskId AND thw.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN TaskEx tx ON t.Id = tx.TaskId AND tx.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN TaskSPV spv ON t.Id = spv.TaskId AND spv.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN TaskSOGL sgl ON t.Id = sgl.TaskId AND sgl.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN Taskclose tskcl ON t.Id = tskcl.TaskId AND tskcl.RowNum = 1
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[TaskTypeComboBox] reg ON reg.Id = t.Data.value('(//field[@id=1225]/text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(MAX)')
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[User] usr ON t.CreatorId = usr.Id
  WHERE 
    t.ServiceId NOT IN (16, 18, 19, 20, 55, 61, 65, 66, 70, 71, 72, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78, 79, 80, 84, 86, 88, 89, 93, 94, 95, 96, 101, 103, 105, 106, 110, 112, 114, 120, 123, 131, 133, 135, 136, 137, 140, 160, 162, 155, 152, 25, 29, 54, 146, 158, 147, 155, 166)
    AND t.Created > @StartDate
    AND (t.Categories IS NULL OR (
      t.Categories NOT LIKE '%Focalist заказ РМ%'
      AND t.Categories NOT LIKE '%Подменное оборудование%'
      AND t.Categories NOT LIKE '%Снятие Счётчиков%'
      AND t.Categories NOT LIKE '%Запрос информации%'
      AND t.Categories NOT LIKE 'ТО'
      AND t.Categories NOT LIKE '%Техническое обслуживание%'
    ))
) as CATtask 
WHERE 
    (Категории NOT LIKE 'Удалить' OR Категории IS NULL)
ORDER BY [№] DESC

name: Дедлайны - Качество
sqlQuery:
DECLARE @StartDate DATETIME = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0);
WITH TaskWait AS (
    SELECT 
        TaskId,
        Changed,
		Data,
        BlocksChanged,
		EditorId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId] ORDER BY [Changed] ASC) AS RowNum,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY [TaskId]) AS TaskIdRowCount
    FROM 
        [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[TaskHistory]
    WHERE 
        Changed >= @StartDate and [BlocksChanged] LIKE '%field7367%' 
)

SELECT
  t.[Id] AS 'Номер заявки',
  FORMAT(tw1.Changed, 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm') AS 'Дата изменения',
  usr.Name AS 'ФИО изменившего',
  ttc.NameXml.value('(//Language/Ru)[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Качество',
  t.Data.value('(//field[@id=7368]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS 'Комментарий'
FROM [is4_lanta_repl].[dbo].[Task] t
INNER JOIN
  TaskWait tw1 ON t.Id = tw1.TaskId 
LEFT JOIN
	dbo.[User] usr ON tw1.EditorId = usr.Id
LEFT JOIN
    dbo.TaskTypeComboBox ttc ON t.Data.value('(//field[@id=7367]/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') = ttc.Id
WHERE t.Changed >= @StartDate 
ORDER BY tw1.Changed DESC;
